verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a hardware system-on-chip, and a downloadable machine-readable API spec such as OpenAPI belongs to software services with web or HTTP APIs, so the axis is a category error for this product. The Metal 4, Core ML and Foundation Models evidence describes host-platform programming frameworks, not a spec shipped by the chip itself, so it does not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
